key.name: hanging
key.description: Kept so the line survives locking the screen and logging out.

key.name: folder
key.description: Empty means the folder GNOME saves screenshots to, ~/Pictures/Screenshots.

key.name: max-items
key.summary: How many screenshots hang at once

key.name: card-size
key.description: How much of the screen's width each screenshot takes, in percent.

key.name: peek-on-new
key.summary: Show each new screenshot for a moment

key.name: edge-reveal
key.summary: Bring the line down by pushing the pointer against the top edge

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar

key.name: editor
key.summary: App used to mark up screenshots
key.description: A desktop file id such as com.github.maoschanz.drawing.desktop. Empty means the first one found of Drawing, Pinta, KolourPaint and GIMP.
